extraction.Name: George Brown Jr
extraction.Refused/Protested: decidedly did not want his patent in fee, but receipted for it for the reason that the Agent asked him to, and he did not want to be a kicker and out of line with the Office
extraction.Recorded patent: he did not have the patent recorded, but that he later mortgaged the land and the mortgagee had it recorded
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: mortgaged the land to apply on a bunch of 100 head of cattle, that cattle went down, and when they were disposed of, they did not pay for themselves and the mortgage on my allotment was foreclosed, to make up the difference
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: cattle went down, and when they were disposed of, they did not pay for themselves and the mortgage on my allotment was foreclosed, to make up the difference
extraction.Occupation/Income: working for the Government at Rapid City Indian School, as painter
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent and in good health; has a wife and three children dependent on him for support; Government, State or County has not contributed to his support; foreclosure occurred in 1919 and 1920; document sworn November 1, 1928, in County of Shannon, State of South Dakota | ORIGINAL_TRIBE_VALUE: "Shannon County (South Dakota)" (normalized 2026-04-28 to canonical 'Pine Ridge')

recovery_notes.rationale: Pine Ridge tribe field had 40+ string variants across the corpus. Consolidating to canonical 'Pine Ridge' for clean tabulation while preserving original variant in NOTES for audit.
